full_name: Rebecca Lemov | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Shutzer Fellow Harvard University
bio: Rebecca Lemov is a historian of science at Harvard whose most recent book is The Instability of Truth: Brainwashing, Mind Control, and Hyper-Persuasion (W. W. Norton, 2025). While at Radcliffe, she will explore episodes in historical and present-day psychedelic research and their possible connection to the suggestibility seen in brainwashing.
